description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to scrolling behavior in a UI, including scheduling scrolls, handling user scroll events, exporting logs, and observing UI elements like the top bar.

classes.name: ScrollHost
classes.description: Type defining the structure of the scroll management object, including promises, DOM elements, and state flags related to chat and log scrolling.

methods.name: queryHost
methods.description: Helper function to query DOM elements within a host object using selectors.

methods.name: scheduleChatScroll
methods.description: Schedules automatic scrolling of the chat container, with options for forcing scroll and smooth behavior.

methods.name: scheduleLogsScroll
methods.description: Schedules automatic scrolling of the logs container, with an option to force scroll.

methods.name: handleChatScroll
methods.description: Handles user scroll events on the chat container, updating state flags based on scroll position.

methods.name: handleLogsScroll
methods.description: Handles user scroll events on the logs container, updating the 'at bottom' state flag.

methods.name: resetChatScroll
methods.description: Resets chat scroll state flags to initial values.

methods.name: exportLogs
methods.description: Exports log lines to a downloadable text file with timestamped filename.

methods.name: observeTopbar
methods.description: Sets up a ResizeObserver to monitor the top bar element's height and update CSS variables accordingly.
